answer.rationale: Two of the three current symptoms are funnel-mechanics problems (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%), and onboarding is upstream of activation, so fixing it plausibly recovers both. Two independent inherited records point the same way (memory_86 on shortened onboarding lifting completion and time-to-value; memory_31 on signup simplification producing a durable first-week activation lift), which is stronger convergent support than any single-memory direction. I want memory_86 verified because it is the load-bearing record for the action I intend and I should not commit a whole non-carryover slot on an unexamined archived summary; the summary language ('improved completion rates and time-to-value') may conceal whether the lift was on completion only or actually reached qualified revenue. I want memory_73 verified precisely because promotional pricing is the emotionally obvious answer to the competitor's entry pricing, and that memory carries a self-flagged defect: the readout pooled two cohorts after a mid-test redefinition. If that confound inflated the reported acquisition/revenue lift, then the strongest apparent case for the pricing response is partly an artifact, and I want to know that before the competitive pressure talks me into it. Deliberately not verifying memory_57 or memory_44 since referral incentives and enterprise sales-assist address neither symptom this quarter. Downstream risk flagged on two counts: (1) promotional pricing would likely buy discount-anchored, price-sensitive accounts whose revenue is not sustainable and which reset expectations for renewal, directly against the primary objective; (2) my own chosen action has a real risk too, since cutting required signup fields removes qualification data, so activation could rise while qualified revenue falls. I will therefore instrument the onboarding test on downstream qualified-pipeline quality, not just completion and activation rates. Holding this at a standard experiment rather than broad rollout: the inherited evidence is from days 12-61 on a pre-competitor market, the environment has demonstrably shifted, and a measured test preserves the option to pivot to pricing next cycle if verification of memory_86 comes back weaker or memory_73 comes back clean.
